test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Rs. 12,000 is lent for one year at the rate of 15% per annum, the interest being compounded annually. If the compounding of the interest is done half-yearly, then how much more interest will be obtained at the end of the one-year period on the same initial sum?
solution:
**Given:**

Rs. 12,000 is lent for one year at the rate of 15% per annum

**Concept used:**

C.I = P(1 + R/100)T - P

Here,

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

**Calculation:**

Interest in half yearly

12000(1 + 15/200)² - 12000

⇒ 12000(43/40)2 - 12000

⇒ 12000 × 1849/1600 - 12000

⇒ 13867.5 - 12000

⇒ 1867.5

Interest for 1 year = 12000 × 15%

⇒ 1800

Difference = 1867.5 - 1800

⇒ 67.5

**∴ The required answer is Rs. 67.5.**
